# matrix-label-formatter — implementation plan

> Requirement: `/workspace/requirements/matrix-label-formatter.yaml`
> `fix(matrix): fix matrix label formatter does not work`

---

## 1. Goal

`matrix.x.label.formatter`, `matrix.y.label.formatter`, `matrix.body.label.formatter`,
`matrix.corner.label.formatter` (and the per-cell overrides
`matrix.x/y.data[i].label.formatter`, `matrix.body/corner.data[i].label.formatter`)
are currently **completely ignored**. The matrix view always renders the raw cell value.

Two concrete defects:

1. **Runtime**: `MatrixView#createMatrixCell` builds the label text as `textValue + ''` and hands
   it to `setLabelStyle` as `opt.defaultText`, without a `labelFetcher`. `getLabelText()` in
   `src/label/labelStyle.ts` only reads `normalModel.get('formatter')` **inside the
   `if (labelFetcher)` branch**, so with no fetcher the formatter is never read.
2. **Typing**: `MatrixCellStyleOption['label']` is typed as the plain `LabelOption`, which has
   **no** `formatter` member at all (it is explicitly commented out in `src/util/types.ts`), so
   even declaring a formatter is a TS error for TS users.

After the fix:

* a **string** formatter is expanded as a simple template (`'{name}'`, `'{value}'`, `'{coord}'` …)
  via `formatTplSimple`;
* a **function** formatter is invoked and its (non-null) return value is used as the label text;
* the callback receives a documented params object:
  `{componentType: 'matrix', componentIndex, name, value, coord, $vars}` where `coord` is the
  `[xLocator, yLocator]` pair already used for the matrix tooltip (`MatrixXYLocator[]`);
* a new public type `MatrixLabelOption` / `MatrixLabelFormatterParams` is exported from
  `src/coord/matrix/MatrixModel.ts` and used for `MatrixCellStyleOption['label']`, so the option
  is type-checked.

---

## 2. Findings (current code)

### 2.1 The label text is hard-wired to the raw value

content.text: I have the exact upstream change identified. Writing the plan.

input.summary: Unify all label-layout geometry (margin, bounding rect, transform, OBB) behind one helper API in `src/label/labelLayoutHelper.ts`: replace the `LabelLayoutInfoRaw/Computed` "kind" model with a dirty-bit `LabelLayoutData`/`LabelGeometry` model computed by a single `computeLabelGeometry()` that handles `textMargin` (local rect) and `minMargin` (global rect) plus `marginForce`/`minMarginForce`/`marginDefault` overrides. Then make pie label layout, axis label/name layout, axis-break label moving and `LabelManager` all use it, so labels moved during layout get their rect/transform/OBB synced (`labelLayoutApplyTranslation`, `setLabelLayoutDirty`) and `hideOverlap` reflects the final rendered geometry. This is upstream apache/echarts PR #21103 ("Fix/label layout margin", merge commit e1948aa3, head 8dbf8295), whose base equals this workspace modulo an unrelated typo-cleanup commit.
steps: REFERENCE (highly recommended, network is reachable from this sandbox): the exact upstream diff is `curl -sSL https://github.com/apache/echarts/pull/21103.diff`. I verified with `patch -p1 --dry-run` on a copy of /workspace/src that ALL source hunks apply cleanly EXCEPT hunk #18 of src/component/axis/AxisBuilder.ts (the `fixMinMaxLabelShow` rewrite), which fails only because this workspace still has the pre-typo-fix spellings (`thougth`, `bouding`, `unoin`, `becuase`, `defualt`). Apply that one hunk by hand (step 12). Final upstream file contents: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apache/echarts/8dbf8295e6f527db1cac317ce674bc2be5760e73/<path>.

STEP 1 - src/util/types.ts: delete the whole block at lines 1345-1356 (`/** PENDING: Temporary impl. unify them? ... */ export const LabelMarginType = { minMargin: 0, textMargin: 1 } as const; export interface LabelExtendedTextStyle extends TextStyleProps { __marginType?: ... }`). These move to `src/label/labelStyle.ts` (step 2) with NEW numeric values `minMargin: 1, textMargin: 2` (so `0` is no longer a valid type and `marginType == null` is a meaningful check). Also append to the `minMargin` doc comment (after line 1317 `See the summary in \`textMargin\`.`): `
     *
     * [CAUTION]: do not set \`minMargin\` in \`defaultOption\`, otherwise users have to explicitly
     *  clear the \`minMargin\` to use \`textMargin\`.`

STEP 4 - src/label/labelLayoutHelper.ts (CORE, ~lines 20-246 rewritten): imports become `import { LabelLayoutOption, NullUndefined } from '../util/types';`, `import { BoundingRect, OrientedBoundingRect, Polyline, WH, XY, ensureCopyRect, ensureCopyTransform, expandOrShrinkRect, isBoundingRectAxisAligned } from '../util/graphic';`, drop `each, extend, retrieve2` from zrender util and drop `normalizeCssArray` from '../util/format', and add `import { LabelExtendedTextStyle, LabelMarginType } from './labelStyle';`. DELETE `LABEL_LAYOUT_INFO_KIND_RAW`/`_COMPUTED` (lines 34-35), `LabelLayoutInfoAll` (39), `LabelLayoutInfoRaw` (63-66), `LabelLayoutInfoComputed` (68-74), `LabelIntersectionCheckInfo` (76-91), `createLabelLayoutList` (93-106), `prepareLabelLayoutInfo` (118-157), `rollbackToLabelLayoutInfoRaw` (162-171), `ensureLabelLayoutInfoComputed` (187-197), `prepareIntersectionCheckInfo` (199-211), `createSingleLayoutInfoComputed` (213-220), `applyTextMarginToLocalRect` (235-246).

STEP 5 - src/label/labelLayoutHelper.ts new type model (replacing what step 4 deleted): rename `LabelLayoutInfoBase` -> `interface LabelLayoutBase` keeping `label/labelLine/layoutOption/priority/defaultAttr/suggestIgnore`, REMOVING `ignoreMargin?: boolean` and ADDING three margin-override props: `marginForce?: (number | NullUndefined)[] | NullUndefined` (replaces user `textMargin`/`minMargin`, format `[top, right, bottom, left]`, per-slot `null` = keep original), `minMarginForce?: (number | NullUndefined)[] | NullUndefined` (backward compat: only applied when the label's marginType is `minMargin`), `marginDefault?: number[] | NullUndefined` (used only when neither textMargin nor minMargin is set). Add `const LABEL_LAYOUT_BASE_PROPS = ['label', 'labelLine', 'layoutOption', 'priority', 'defaultAttr', 'marginForce', 'minMarginForce', 'marginDefault', 'suggestIgnore'] as const;`. Add `export interface LabelGeometry { label: Pick<ZRText, 'ignore'>; dirty: (typeof LABEL_LAYOUT_DIRTY_ALL) | NullUndefined; rect: BoundingRect; axisAligned: boolean; obb: OrientedBoundingRect | NullUndefined; localRect: BoundingRect; transform: number[] | NullUndefined }`. Add `export type LabelLayoutData = LabelLayoutBase & Partial<LabelGeometry>;` and `export type LabelLayoutWithGeometry = LabelLayoutBase & LabelGeometry;`. Add dirty bits + accessors: `const LABEL_LAYOUT_DIRTY_BIT_OTHERS = 1 as const; const LABEL_LAYOUT_DIRTY_BIT_OBB = 2 as const; const LABEL_LAYOUT_DIRTY_ALL = LABEL_LAYOUT_DIRTY_BIT_OTHERS | LABEL_LAYOUT_DIRTY_BIT_OBB;`, `export function setLabelLayoutDirty(labelGeometry: Partial<LabelGeometry>, dirtyOrClear: boolean, dirtyBits?: number): void { dirtyBits = dirtyBits || LABEL_LAYOUT_DIRTY_ALL; dirtyOrClear ? (labelGeometry.dirty |= dirtyBits) : (labelGeometry.dirty &= ~dirtyBits); }` and `function isLabelLayoutDirty(labelGeometry, dirtyBits?) { dirtyBits = dirtyBits || LABEL_LAYOUT_DIRTY_ALL; return labelGeometry.dirty == null || !!(labelGeometry.dirty & dirtyBits); }` (note: `dirty == null` means dirty, so freshly-created plain objects compute on first use).

input.risks: This is upstream apache/echarts PR #21103 (8 commits, merge e1948aa3). I confirmed the workspace tree is byte-identical to the PR's first-commit parent 6e5a8a75 for src/label/labelLayoutHelper.ts, src/label/LabelManager.ts and src/chart/pie/labelLayout.ts; src/component/axis/AxisBuilder.ts and src/util/graphic.ts differ only by an unrelated typo-cleanup commit (a separate requirement in requirements/typo-cleanup.yaml) — because of that, the `fixMinMaxLabelShow` hunk cannot be applied mechanically (see step 12), and upstream's context lines contain typo fixes ("unoin"->"union", "thougth"->"thought", "becuase"->"because", "defualt"->"default", "stretegy"->"strategy", "Canculate"->"Calculate") that you may or may not want to pull in here. Semantic risks: (1) `LabelMarginType` values change from `{minMargin:0,textMargin:1}` to `{minMargin:1,textMargin:2}` and `style.margin` becomes an always-normalized 4-array holding `minMargin/2` — any code still treating `label.style.margin` as a plain number breaks (pie was the only such place; grep for `style.margin` before finishing). (2) `ensureLabelLayoutWithGeometry` no longer drops entries whose `defaultAttr.ignore` is true — LabelManager.layout must do that filtering (step 10) or hidden labels will re-enter overlap resolution. (3) `hideOverlap` no longer restores `ignore`; every caller that relied on that must call `restoreIgnore` first (only LabelManager did). (4) `labelIntersect` now returns false when either side's cached `label.ignore` is true — this intentionally changes hideOverlap results slightly (upstream marked test/runTest/marks/axis-break-2.json for it). (5) The PR depends on ecomfe/zrender#1134; node_modules has zrender 6.0.0-rc.1, which I verified provides `OrientedBoundingRect()` no-arg ctor + `fromBoundingRect`, `matrix.copy/create`, `BoundingRect.copy`, `normalizeCssArray` in core/util, `Point.scale`, and TSpan bounding rects that already include the auto stroke width — so dropping pie's `+2.1` is correct here, but visual output shifts by ~1px on pie labels. (6) `defaultTextMargin` stays declared in labelStyle's `TextCommonParams` but becomes unused; keep it (upstream did) to avoid unrelated churn. (7) `expandOrShrinkRect` gains a `__DEV__` assert on 4-length arrays, which will now throw in dev if any caller passes a 2-length margin array — axisDefault's `axisLabel.textMargin: [0, 3]` is fine because labelStyle normalizes it, but check any other direct callers.
